caveats: ⚑ skill1/skill2 trigger identity is KIT-SILENT — neither block carries an activation clause, so both are modeled as interval-fired on the datamined skill cooldown (⚑ 40s placeholder taken from the unit's burst cooldown field, NOT a datamined per-skill cooldown). Cadence drives how often the shield/heal events fire, which is the ONLY damage-relevant output of this kit (tandem consumers: on-shielded / on-recovery kits).

⚑ Shield/heal magnitudes (13.71% / 32.9% of caster Max HP, 65.81% lifesteal) are recorded for kit completeness only — the sim models no HP pool, so their NUMERIC values move no damage. What matters is that the shield/recovery EVENTS fire, and their target set + cadence.

⚑ 'Affects 2 allies with the highest final ATK' is modeled with byFinalAtk:true (literal 'final ATK' wording) and WITHOUT excludeSelf (the kit does not say 'except the skill user') — folkwang is a Defender, so she is unlikely to be in her own top-2 by ATK, making excludeSelf near-inert either way.
Taunt is SKIPPED: the v1 boss is scripted and has no aggro model, so a taunt changes nothing in the sim. It is NOT a damage-adjacent line (no shots/weapon-state effect).

'Incoming healing ▲' is SKIPPED: the sim models no HP amounts, so a healing-received multiplier has no consumer. It does not gate any recovery EVENT (heal events still fire), so no on-recovery tandem synergy is lost.

maxHpPct self-buff is retained despite being offensively inert for folkwang herself (no atkOfMaxHpPct in her kit) — it is kept per the HP/DEF-scaler prior as a future consumer, and because it self-scales her own shield output (shields are % of HER final Max HP).
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. folkwang (AR/Water/Defender/Burst II) is a pure sustain kit: every line is shield / heal / taunt / self-Max-HP. She contributes ZERO direct damage effects. Her only damage-relevant channel is TANDEM: the shield events (skill1 + burst, 2 highest-final-ATK allies) fire teammates' `shielded` triggers, and the burst's over-time recovery fires their `recovery` triggers — per the hard rule that heal/shield/DEF/HP/lifesteal lines are never skipped on isolation. The burst lifesteal (65.81% of attack damage as HP over 10 sec) is modeled as a 10-tick heal (1s interval) so on-recovery consumers stay refreshed across the window rather than seeing a single instant event. Both non-burst skills are ⚑ interval-triggered at an ESTIMATED cadence — the kit prose gives no activation clause for either, which is the single largest uncertainty in this baseline.

flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #2: the kit gives skill1 NO activation clause, so both the trigger KIND and its cadence are invented. Per the trigger-identity rule a clause-free line is `interval`. The 40s value is borrowed from the unit's burst cooldown field because no per-skill cooldown was supplied in the packet — it is NOT a datamined skill cooldown and could easily be 15–30s. Cadence is load-bearing here: it sets how OFTEN teammates' `shielded` triggers fire, which is folkwang's only damage-relevant output. Also ⚑ the first-fire phase (t=sec vs t=0) — the interval convention first-fires at t=sec; a force-cast-style first-fire at t=0 would add one extra shield window over a 180s fight.
flags.recipe: Read data/skillCooldownsSec (or the datamined skill table) for folkwang's skill1 cooldown and substitute it. To confirm empirically: run a comp with a shield-gated consumer (a `shielded`-trigger or `requiresShielded` unit) alongside folkwang, log buffApply/shield events with cfg.onEvent, and count shield applications over 180s — N applications ⇒ cadence ≈ 180/N, and whether the first lands at t≈0 or t≈cadence pins the phase.

flags.reasoning: The kit says 'highest FINAL ATK' literally, which per the target-schema rule selects live effectiveAtk ranking rather than static ranking. `excludeSelf` is omitted because the kit does not carry the 'except the skill user' clause — but note folkwang is a Defender (base class ATK 78,707 at scope lock), so she is essentially never in her own top-2 and the choice is near-inert on any real comp. flags.estimate: ticks:10, intervalSec:1 (10 recovery events over the 10s window)
flags.reasoning: The kit says 'over 10 sec' but does NOT state a tick interval, so the 1s/10-tick decomposition is an invented cadence. It matters only for on-recovery consumers: 10 events keep a `recovery`-triggered buff refreshed for the full window, whereas 1 instant event would let such a buff lapse. Chose the refresh-preserving reading because a continuous lifesteal is genuinely continuous in game; the alternative (single event) would UNDER-credit a tandem partner. Erring the other way (e.g. 30 ticks) would OVER-fire a per-event consumer.
flags.recipe: Pair folkwang with an on-recovery consumer (crown-style 'when recovery takes effect' buff) in a test comp and count that consumer's buffApply events during folkwang's burst window; the real refresh count pins ticks. Alternatively read popup/heal-number cadence off a recording of her burst.

Critically, it does NOT gate recovery EVENTS — the tandem channel that actually matters is preserved.

flags.estimate: ZERO direct damage effects — folkwang is damage-inert in isolation
flags.reasoning: Whole-picture check: every one of the six kit lines is shield / heal / taunt / self-Max-HP. There is no flatDamage, no dot, no ATK/crit/core/damage-taken buff, no weapon-state modifier (no reload/ammo/fire-rate/charge/swap line), so nothing changes shots fired or damage per shot. A solo folkwang run should therefore be indistinguishable from her raw weapon output — if a board reading shows otherwise, the model, not this baseline, is wrong.
flags.recipe: Run folkwang in a controlComp and diff her damage against the same comp with all three slots emptied — the delta should be exactly 0 for her own damage. Any non-zero delta on a TEAMMATE is the legitimate tandem channel (their shielded/recovery triggers) and confirms the shield/heal events are firing.
